templates.title: 15-Arc Master Daily Routine
templates.description: Complete self-improvement system covering all 15 life arcs: Winter, Gym, Study, Career, Money, Monk, Spiritual, Health, Knowledge, Discipline, Glow-Up, Reset, Build, Peace, Transformation.

habits.name: Wake Up + Make Bed + Drink Water

templates.title: Winter Arc — Discipline & Consistency
templates.description: Build iron discipline and consistency. 5:30 AM wake up, workout daily, complete Top 3 priorities, study, sleep by 10:30 PM. Never miss twice.

habits.name: Daily Review — What Did I Execute?

templates.title: Gym Arc — Strength & Fitness
templates.description: Build strength, fitness and physical consistency. Structured weekly split: upper/lower/cardio. 20–30 min movement even on rest days.

templates.title: Study Arc — Focused Learning
templates.description: Structured academic or technical learning. 45 min focused study + 10 min practice + 5 min review each session. Mon–Thu: new concepts. Fri: revision. Sat: practice. Sun: review.

templates.title: Career Arc — Professional Growth
templates.description: Accelerate professional capability. Deep work blocks, skill learning, architecture, performance, AI/ML, documentation. Choose one career skill as weekly focus.

templates.title: Money Arc — Finance & Wealth
templates.description: Control personal finances daily. Record expenses, track spending, review savings. Weekly: spending review + savings rate. Monthly: net-worth update, budget review.

templates.title: Monk Arc — Focus & No Distraction
templates.description: Reduce distractions and reclaim attention. No social media at wake-up. No phone during deep work. Batch notifications. Digital shutdown after 10 PM.

habits.name: Wake Up — No Phone for 30 Min

templates.title: Spiritual Arc — Meditation & Reflection
templates.description: Develop reflection, gratitude and inner discipline. Morning meditation/prayer/breathing. Evening quiet reflection. Choose your practice.

templates.title: Health Arc — Nutrition, Sleep & Recovery
templates.description: Support energy, recovery and long-term health. Balanced meals, adequate protein, hydration, daily movement, consistent sleep, limit processed food.

templates.title: Knowledge Arc — Reading & Broad Learning
templates.description: Become broadly knowledgeable. Read consistently in technology, science, business, history, philosophy. Focus on consistency over page counts.

habits.name: Note Key Insight of the Day

templates.title: Discipline Arc — Execution & Time Management
templates.description: Execute what you plan. Morning: write Top 3 priorities. Night: review what you completed, what you avoided, what caused distraction.

templates.title: Glow-Up Arc — Grooming & Confidence
templates.description: Improve presentation, grooming and confidence. Morning: shower, skincare, hair, clean clothes. Weekly: hair/beard maintenance, nail care, clothing organization.

templates.title: Reset Arc — Remove Bad Habits
templates.description: Remove what's holding you back and rebuild. Daily: identify one bad habit to reduce and one good habit to strengthen. Sunday: full weekly reset.

habits.name: Identify Today's Bad Habit to Reduce

templates.title: Build Arc — Projects & Portfolio
templates.description: Build something tangible every week. Android apps, open-source, portfolio, AI tools, automation, side projects. Build > consume. Aim for visible output weekly.

habits.name: Review Build Output of the Week (Sun)

templates.title: Peace Arc — Mental Space & Calm
templates.description: Protect mental space and reduce unnecessary stress. Quiet time daily, phone-free walks, meaningful time with family/friends, organized workspace.

templates.title: Transformation Arc — Full Life System
templates.description: Combine the strongest elements of all 15 arcs into a sustainable lifestyle. Transformation is not a separate routine — it is the result of executing the other arcs consistently.
